The '''B28 ''Extinction''-class bomber''', also referred to as the '''B-28''', was a [[Bomber/Legends|Bomber]] class used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Great Galactic War]] and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] saw extensive use during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], wherein [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of the vessel devastated much of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] cityscape. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Keizar-Volvec bulk cruiser]] ''[[Paramount]]'' carried several B-28s and used them to bombard the planet [[Sebaddon]] during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]] in [[3643 BBY]].

Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], a functional model of the bomber existed.
